title: Unweighted uniform L¹ and variation bounds from the frozen weighted hypothesis (step A0)
statement: For every n ∈ ℕ, every open W ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) with Lⁿ(W) < ∞, and every sequence u_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) such that sup_k ∫⁻_W (‖u_k(x)‖ₑ + |Du_k|(W)) dx < ∞ in [0,∞], where |Du_k|(W) := SimonGMT Chapter02.bvVariationOn (u k) W ∈ [0,∞] is an x-independent constant inside the integrand, there is a real c ≥ 0 such that for every k: ∫⁻_W ‖u_k(x)‖ₑ dx ≤ ofReal c and |Du_k|(W) ≤ ofReal c.
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (W : Set (Rn n)) (u : ℕ → Rn n → ℝ), IsOpen W → volume W < ⊤ → ⨆ k, (∫⁻ x in W, ‖u k x‖ₑ + Chapter02.bvVariationOn (u k) W) < ⊤ → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 ≤ c ∧ ∀ k, (∫⁻ x in W, ‖u k x‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c ∧ Chapter02.bvVariationOn (u k) W ≤ ENNReal.ofReal c
